title: WorldsIndex conflict-set shard (worldsindex-conflict-sets.v1)
description: worldsindex/data/conflicts/<xx>.json.gz: the per-object conflict-set products of the objects whose id hashes to the shard (first two hex digits of sha256(objectId), as details/). One row per source assertion pointing at its source record; a conflict set (an extended ConflictRecord) per property with two or more rows, labelled with the contract relation vocabulary at k sigma; selections by rule nasa-pscomppars-like.v1 (a selection, not a measurement); dated publications for the time-evolution plot; status claims and Exo-MerCat reconciliation flags. Absent values are omitted.
